questions.q: In AI safety via debate, what is each debater actually rewarded for?
options: Winning the argument in front of the judge, regardless of an absolute notion of being right
Agreeing with the other debater as quickly as possible
Being provably correct according to a separate ground-truth checker
Producing the longest possible response
questions.explain: Debate rewards winning the argument; the hope is that this incentive structure makes honesty the dominant strategy because dishonest claims are more exposed to rebuttal.

questions.q: What is debate's central wager about verification and generation?
options: That verification and generation always require the same amount of effort
That a judge must be more skilled than both debaters combined
That generating a correct answer is always easier than verifying one
That verifying whether a specific argument is correct is often far easier than generating the correct answer from scratch
questions.explain: Debate leans on the idea that a judge who can't solve a hard problem alone may still be able to follow and check a specific argument, similar to how a debate referee doesn't need to out-argue the contestants.

questions.q: What did the 'Debate Helps Supervise Unreliable Experts' study find when comparing debate to a single unchallenged expert (consultancy)?
options: There was no measurable difference between the two methods
Debate gave the judge meaningfully higher accuracy than the consultancy baseline where one expert argued unchallenged
The study found debate only works when the judge sees the full source passage
Consultancy produced meaningfully higher judge accuracy than debate
questions.explain: The study found debate reached meaningfully higher judge accuracy than consultancy, supporting the idea that an adversarial structure helps a judge who can't independently verify the material.

questions.q: What is the most-discussed failure mode of debate as an oversight method?
options: Debate always takes far longer to run than any other oversight method
Debate cannot be run with more than one judge at a time
Debate can reward persuasiveness over truth, letting a skilled debater win by exploiting a judge's blind spots rather than by being correct
Debate only works on multiple-choice questions
questions.explain: A core, acknowledged weakness is that a sufficiently skilled but dishonest debater might win through rhetorical tricks or exploiting ambiguity rather than through being correct.

questions.q: On what kind of question does debate's theoretical guarantee offer the least traction?
options: Open-ended, values-laden questions where there is no single fact for a rebuttal to expose
Questions with a crisp, checkable resolution that a rebuttal could directly expose as wrong
Questions where both debaters already agree on the answer
Simple arithmetic questions with one numeric answer
questions.explain: Debate's guarantees are strongest where there is a specific fact or flaw that an opponent can point to and the judge can check; open-ended values questions lack that crisp resolution.
